svg.title: Blob-to-SQL Infrastructure Diagram
svg.desc: Architecture diagram for the Blob-to-SQL project: GitHub Actions deploys with OIDC into an Azure resource group; a CSV upload to the data storage account raises a BlobCreated event, Event Grid calls the Import-CsvBlob function on Flex Consumption, the function upserts rows into Azure SQL and moves the file to the processed container, or to the failed container with an error report. Icons: Microsoft Azure Architecture Icons (V23).
svg.text: Repository-driven Azure deployment with GitHub OIDC, Terraform, Function Flex Consumption, Event Grid and Azure SQL
PR: tests, terraform plan, dacpac preview
1st run: 2nd apply adds Event Grid sub
RBAC on subscription and state backend
Created by setup script, remote locking
Holds function host key for the webhook
Terraform-managed, location and tags from variables
reads the blob, then moves it to processed, or to failed with <name>.error.txt
Deploy order: terraform apply → delete AzureWebJobsStorage setting → SqlPackage publishes BlobToSqlDb.dacpac → function zip deploy.
First deploy: a second terraform apply creates the Event Grid subscription, because the webhook endpoint exists only after the code is live.
